# ScriptClientShake

*Client*

Settings of a camera shake, created by `scram.shake()` and started with the camera's `shake` or

`impulse`. Setters return this shake, so calls can be chained.

## Methods

### noise {#noise}

::: member

Sets the motion of the shake.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `noise` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | `"smooth_random"` (default, natural shaking), `"sine"` (regular waves) or `"none"`; unknown names are smooth_random |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### frequency {#frequency}

::: member

Sets how fast the camera moves back and forth, on all axes.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hz` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | oscillations per second; 18 by default |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### frequency {#frequency-2}

::: member

Sets how fast the camera moves back and forth, separately for offset and rotation.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `posHz` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | oscillations per second of the offset |
| `rotHz` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | oscillations per second of the rotation |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### frequencies {#frequencies}

::: member

Sets the oscillations per second of every axis.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `posX` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the offset along x |
| `posY` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the offset along y |
| `posZ` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the offset along z |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the pitch |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the yaw |
| `roll` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the roll |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### posFrequency {#posfrequency}

::: member

Sets the oscillations per second of the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | along x |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | along y |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | along z |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### rotFrequency {#rotfrequency}

::: member

Sets the oscillations per second of the rotation.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the pitch |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the yaw |
| `roll` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | of the roll |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### posMagnitude {#posmagnitude}

::: member

Sets how far the camera moves at full strength; 0 by default, so set it or [`rotMagnitude`](#rotmagnitude).

```js
var shake = scram.shake().posMagnitude(0.05, 0.05, 0).rotMagnitude(1, 1, 2).sustain(20);

c.getPlayer().getCamera().shake("hit", shake);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest offset along x, in blocks |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest offset along y, in blocks |
| `z` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest offset along z, in blocks |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### rotMagnitude {#rotmagnitude}

::: member

Sets how far the camera turns at full strength; 0 by default.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest pitch change in degrees |
| `yaw` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest yaw change in degrees |
| `roll` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | largest roll in degrees |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### fadeIn {#fadein}

::: member

Sets how long a timed shake (`shake`) takes to reach full strength.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks; 2 by default |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### sustain {#sustain}

::: member

Sets how long a timed shake stays at full strength after fading in.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks; 0 by default, negative shakes until stopped |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### fadeOut {#fadeout}

::: member

Sets how long a timed shake takes to calm down after sustaining.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | ticks; 10 by default |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### falloff {#falloff}

::: member

Sets the curve of the fades, and of the strength from the trauma of an impulse.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `interpolation` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | BBS interpolation name, like `"linear"` (default) or `"quad_in"`; unknown names are linear |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### decay {#decay}

::: member

Sets how fast the trauma of an impulse (`impulse`) drops; the shake ends at 0 trauma.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `perSecond` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | trauma lost per second, out of 1; 1.5 by default |

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::

### copy {#copy}

::: member

Returns this shake itself, not a copy. Starting a shake copies its settings, so later changes to this object do not affect a running shake and the object can be reused.

**Returns** [`ScriptClientShake`](/scripting/client/render/ScriptClientShake) — this shake

:::
